answer: Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 20 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. Because the wander cliff is fixed at deposit and entered in the glacier ledger, the ridge audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. A farm of 207 pays that 23 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
